title: Pocketwire Rewards Clawback Relief for Travel and Dining Purchases
content:
When a refunded purchase earned its Pocketwire Rewards points in the travel or dining category, a category relief applies to the clawback.

## Rule

The clawback category relief is 300 points when the earning entry of the refunded purchase carries the travel category, 100 points when it carries the dining category, and nothing for any other category.

The relief is taken off the clawback for the refund, and a clawback is never reduced below zero; on tiers where the clawback is cut to the points balance, the cut applies to the clawback after the relief has been taken off.

The category is read from the earning entry on the points ledger that points to the refunded purchase. Earning entries are the entries that credit base and category points on a card purchase; boost entries, which carry the same purchase's spend, are not earning entries.

## Relief by category

| Category on the earning entry of the refunded purchase | Relief |
|---|---|
| travel | 300 points |
| dining | 100 points |
| grocery, gas, streaming, online retail or any other | nothing |

## Hypothetical cases

- A refunded airline purchase whose earning entry carries the travel category, with a clawback of 540 points: the clawback becomes 240 points.
- A refunded restaurant purchase whose earning entry carries the dining category, with a clawback of 60 points: the clawback becomes 0 points.
